authorization.scope: Send only the two saved MPIF and SMI Gmail drafts once, during the next scheduled campaign run. This supersedes the earlier draft-only instruction for these two messages.

schedulingPolicy: Prioritize this pair within the existing overall limits, reserving two available message slots. For the run processing the pair, send no additional United States pitch and at most two eligible first pitches from the other active markets. First pitches retain their one-per-country limit. Log capacity deferrals and do not accumulate catch-up slots. After this pair is complete, resume the normal campaign. If checks or access block a send, keep only the unsent entry queued for the next eligible scheduled run.
draftPolicy: Send the existing Gmail drafts as saved using gmail_send_draft. Do not recreate, materially rewrite, add recipients, or attach a new demo. Missing or changed drafts require a hold and reconciliation. Record returned Gmail IDs immediately and confirm in Sent before marking verified. Never resend a confirmed follow-up.
